mantras.fr: On avance doucement, mais on avance.
mantras.en: We move gently, but we move.

mantras.fr: On ne force pas ; on suit le courant.
mantras.en: We do not force; we follow the current.
Slowing down is sometimes how we last.

mantras.fr: On reste fidèles à nos origines.
mantras.en: We stay true to our origins.

mantras.fr: Un geste local, un geste doux.
mantras.en: One local act, one gentle act.

mantras.fr: Recover & heal : on a le droit de se soigner.
mantras.en: Recover and heal: we are allowed to care for ourselves.
